title: Epilepsy
summary: Epilepsy, documented by a detailed description of a typical seizure, characterized by A) GTC seizures monthly for 3 months despite treatment, B) dyscognitive seizures weekly for 3 months despite treatment, C) GTC seizures every 2 months for 4 months despite treatment WITH marked limitation in 1 of 5 areas, or D) dyscognitive seizures every 2 weeks for 3 months despite treatment WITH marked limitation in 1 of 5 areas.

children.criterion: Epilepsy diagnosis, documented by a detailed description of a typical seizure
Paragraph A, B, C, or D
Generalized tonic-clonic seizures (see 11.00H1a), occurring at least once a month for at least 3 consecutive months (see 11.00H4) despite adherence to prescribed treatment (see 11.00C)
Dyscognitive seizures (see 11.00H1b), occurring at least once a week for at least 3 consecutive months (see 11.00H4) despite adherence to prescribed treatment (see 11.00C)

Generalized tonic-clonic seizures occurring at least once every 2 months for at least 4 consecutive months despite adherence to prescribed treatment AND a marked limitation in one of five functional areas
Generalized tonic-clonic seizures (see 11.00H1a), occurring at least once every 2 months for at least 4 consecutive months (see 11.00H4) despite adherence to prescribed treatment (see 11.00C)
Marked limitation in ONE of the following five areas
Marked limitation in physical functioning (see 11.00G3a)
Marked limitation in understanding, remembering, or applying information (see 11.00G3b(i))
Marked limitation in interacting with others (see 11.00G3b(ii))
Marked limitation in concentrating, persisting, or maintaining pace (see 11.00G3b(iii))
Marked limitation in adapting or managing oneself (see 11.00G3b(iv))
Dyscognitive seizures occurring at least once every 2 weeks for at least 3 consecutive months despite adherence to prescribed treatment AND a marked limitation in one of five functional areas
Dyscognitive seizures (see 11.00H1b), occurring at least once every 2 weeks for at least 3 consecutive months (see 11.00H4) despite adherence to prescribed treatment (see 11.00C)
Marked limitation in ONE of the following five areas
Marked limitation in physical functioning (see 11.00G3a)
Marked limitation in understanding, remembering, or applying information (see 11.00G3b(i))
Marked limitation in interacting with others (see 11.00G3b(ii))
Marked limitation in concentrating, persisting, or maintaining pace (see 11.00G3b(iii))
Marked limitation in adapting or managing oneself (see 11.00G3b(iv))
